modules.name: Link Clock
modules.description: Ableton Link tempo/beat/start-stop transport as a clock, bar reset, and run gate.

modules.name: Link Audio Receive
modules.description: Play an Ableton Link Audio channel (e.g. a WAIL room stream) into Rack, aligned to its beat stamps.

modules.name: Link Audio Receive 16
modules.description: Every WAIL room stream at once: 16 named stereo slots that fill themselves, plus polyphonic outputs.

modules.name: Link Audio Send
modules.description: Publish a Rack stereo input as an Ableton Link Audio channel WAIL (or any Link Audio app) can hear.

modules.name: WAIL
modules.description: The WAIL client inside Rack (embedded core; packaging spike — no session yet).
